# Uchinchi tomon kutubxonalari (MIT)

Shtrix-kod/QR vizualizatsiyasi uchun, CDN'ga bog'liq bo'lmasligi va CSP/SRI muammosi bo'lmasligi uchun repoda saqlanadi.
Faqat kerak bo'lganda (lazy) yuklanadi.

- `JsBarcode.code128.min.js` — JsBarcode 3.11.6 (Code128 qismi), MIT, https://github.com/lindell/JsBarcode
- `qrcode.js` — qrcode-generator 1.4.4, MIT, Kazuhiko Arase, https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator
